verdict.rationale: Deel's founders page states it helps founders 'secure the right visa or green card' and lists O-1A alongside EB-2 NIW and EB-1A, so the green-card categories are offered. Nothing in the evidence describes a continuation strategy linking the O-1 to a later EB-1A/NIW filing. Missing for 10: documented O-1-to-green-card transition strategy, guidance on timing or sequencing EB-1A vs EB-2 NIW after the work visa, reuse of O-1 evidence for the green-card petition, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
